scripts.text:
I am the festival NPC manager for the God SE quest.
Please enter your password.

scripts.speaker: Festival Manager
scripts.text: Password is incorrect.

scripts.speaker: Festival Manager
scripts.text: What would you like to do?
Disable festival NPCs
Enable festival NPCs

scripts.speaker: Festival Manager
scripts.text: Ending festivals and disabling NPCs.

scripts.speaker: Festival Manager
scripts.text: Resetting festivals and enabling NPCs.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text:
This is the flower.
This is just a formality, but let me check your qualifications.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: Your qualification is verified as a Guild master.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: I wonder if you know what this flower's use is... Let me explain it to you.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: This is the holy flower given by the Wish Maiden in Valkyrie, it can summon certain monsters by certain summoners.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text:
There are only two summoners in this world...
Me and my sister Rhehe...

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: We are totllly different, but we can...

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text:
Anyway,
Do you want to summon monsters?
Do not summon
Summon, please

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: I don't like to be interrupted by others..

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: But it's just business.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text:
I will explain to you how to summon monsters.
This flower can summon the monsters 'Valkyrie's Blessing' and 'Valkyrie's Present' for one hour here in Juno.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text:
An announcement will be made stating which monster is summoned.
This festival is given by the Wish maiden for all adventurers to enjoy all over the world.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: Now, are you ready to summon monsters?
No, I'm not ready now.
Yes! I'm ready for that.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: If you are not ready, why did you come to me?

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text:
I'll be waiting until you are ready.
It is just business afterall.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: Now we are ready.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: Ok, we would ge started to summon monsters.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: Have a good time.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: It seems that a Valkyrie's Blessing summoning ritual is already in progress elsewhere.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: Please try again later.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: It seems you are not worthy.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: I don't know how you obtained that flower, but if you're not capable of leading others.. then you cannot continue.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text:
Too tough?
Well, what can you do, that's part of the job.

scripts.speaker: Rmimi Ravies
scripts.text: Don't you have any voucher?

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
A flower!!
Shall we proceed?

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: Eeeeh, so young and yet you're a guild master? Your guildsmen must be jealous.

scripts.speaker: Reumimi Ravies
scripts.text: I'm not sure if you understand the uses for that flower, so I'll briefly explain.

scripts.speaker: Reumimi Ravies
scripts.text:
That flower has been passed down as a gift from the Valkyrie Wish Maiden herself.
It may be used to summon special monsters through summoners in special areas.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
There are only two summoners in existence who are capable of using that flower.
One is me, and the other is my twin sister Reumimi.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: Twin sisters, but we do not have much alike, little fingers in front of you ...

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
..................................
.....Oops! I wasn't supposed to tell anyone...

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
... Hehehe, anyways let's move on.
So do you wish to summon or not!?
Do not summon
Summon

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: ...*Cries*.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
If you've got no business with me, please don't start a conversation.
If it were my sister, she would've humiliated you for it.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
Okay then, I'll explain a little about the summoning ritual.
Here in Juno, the summoning ritual through the use of that flower will summon Valkyrie's Blessing and Valkyrie's Gift.
The effects of the summoning ritual will last approximately one hour.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
During the summoning ritual, continuous broadcasts will be made.
It is a courtesy of the Valkyrie Wish Maiden, in order to unite adventurers from all over to participate in the festival.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: Are you ready to begin the summoning ritual~?
No, not yet.
Yes! I'm ready!

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: You're not even ready, why bother talking to me?

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
Oh well, if you've got other things to do then I'll wait.
After all, that's also part of my job.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: Very well, then I will check for a reasonable time to begin the summoning ritual.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: Good! Now seems like a good time, so let's begin!

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: I hope you enjoy yourself!

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
*Cries*
It doesn't seem like now is a good time.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: Please try again later.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: ...Seems like you're not in a worthy position for me to talk to?

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: I don't know how you obtained that flower, but if you're not capable of leading others.. then you cannot continue.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text:
Too tough?
Well, what can you do, that's part of the job.

scripts.speaker: Rhehe Ravies
scripts.text: Don't you have anything to give me to prove yourself?
